Interface WhoCaller

All Known Implementing Classes:
WhoCaller.Other, WhoCaller.Session, WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential, WhoCaller.SignedOut, WhoCaller.Stateless
public sealed interface WhoCaller permits WhoCaller.SignedOut, WhoCaller.Session, WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential, WhoCaller.Stateless, WhoCaller.Other
Who signed a request in, as WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository.caller(HttpServletRequest, Authentication) tells it: by what signed the request in, never by which headers it carries. Every who endpoint that treats a browser session, a bearer token and an API key differently switches on it.

    WhoCaller.Other
    A who sign-in that no browser session loaded and that is neither a bearer token nor an API key, such as one placed in the security context by the application or a test.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.Session
    A browser session signed the request in, and the request presents no API key or bearer token beside the session cookie.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential
    A browser session signed the request in, but the request also presents an API key or a bearer token, which was ignored because the session had already signed it in.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.SignedOut
    No who sign-in: the request is anonymous, or signed in by something that is not who's.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.Stateless
    A bearer token or an API key signed the request in; no browser session did.
